source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-2

procedures.title: Hood: adjust
steps: Bring the hood top flush with neighboring surfaces by shimming under the hinges and adjusting the bumper screw and catch bolt engagement (specified gaps: see figure 3 in the manual).
To adjust how the catch bolt enters the plate, loosen the 2 catch bolt mounting screws and move the bolt assembly.
To synchronize catch release, adjust the cable retainer at the left-hand catch bolt assembly.

procedures.title: Hood assembly: remove and install
steps: If the hood will be reused, scribe around the hinge upper strap (see figure 4 in the manual).
Have a helper hold the hood; remove the screws holding the hinge straps and support assembly to the hood.
If the hinges come off the car, record the shim count under each hinge.
To install the original hood, line the hinges up with the scribe marks and refit the hinge and support screws.
If adjustment is needed, follow Hood adjustment / hood catch.

procedures.title: Hood prop: retention for service
steps: For lengthy under-hood work, put a 1/4 inch bolt and nut through the existing hole in the prop track and slide so the hood cannot close accidentally.

procedures.title: Front emblem: removal access
steps: Raise the hood to reach the special nuts that hold the front emblem, flags, numbers and molding inserts.

procedures.title: Cowl area trim: remove and install
steps: Right-hand dash pad / instrument panel pad: remove the 2 screws on the outboard flange.
Remove the 2 screws at the inner flange of the center cluster panel.
Pull the pad outward to free the special plastic clips along the panel top.
Pull the pad upward to free the spring clip at the top of the side trim panel.
Cowl ventilator / kick panel (see figure 6 in the manual): loosen the 4 sill plate screws enough to take pressure off the kick panel.
Remove the 1 screw in the center of the kick panel.
Lift the panel out while pushing it rearward.
Left and right side trim panels can then be lifted out by pulling forward and upward to free the 2 spring clips at the front console assembly.
notes: Figure 5 in the manual shows pad and side trim panel mounting.
